extraction_policy.salary_interpretation: Basic salary scale under National Pay Scale 2015; this is not take-home salary.
extraction_policy.inferred_skills: Skills required after joining are explicitly marked as inferred because the circulars primarily establish eligibility rather than a complete competency framework.

cross_source_insights.most_important_new_signal: BRRI's two 2025-2026 circulars dramatically strengthen the Data + Statistics + Agricultural Research pathway for INSYT Corporate. The same institute recruits Data Analyst, Agrometeorological Assistant and Agricultural Statistics Scientific Officer alongside large numbers of Agricultural Scientific Officers.

highest_value_jobs_for_an_agricultural_e.why: Direct data-processing role inside a major agricultural research institute.
Direct bridge between agricultural research and quantitative/statistical science.
Direct research-data support position in a large agricultural research organization.
Very large vacancy count creates a significant recurring agricultural-research employment pathway.

insyt_corporate_product_opportunities.logic: Degree + major + CGPA/class + age + experience + licence + certificate + quota
Agriculture degree → research domain → organization → job → skill pathway
Job role → likely operational competencies → advanced skills → promotion readiness

critical_data_modeling_notes: BARI should be stored as one recruitment cycle containing 30 normalized job records and 191 total vacancies.
BRRI 2025-2026 should NOT be treated as one flat circular because BRRI 3.pdf and BRRI 4.pdf are separate recruitment notices with different job families.

BRRI 4 adds a high-level Editor position plus 30 Agricultural Scientific Officer positions and one Agricultural Statistics Scientific Officer, making it especially important for INSYT's research-career engine.
The distinction between permanent and temporary Scientific Officer positions at BRRI must be preserved.
INSYT should store Bangla original job title and English normalized title separately.
INSYT should store salary grade and salary scale separately.
INSYT should never infer take-home salary from basic salary scale without a separate allowance/deduction dataset.
Experience should be represented numerically where possible, for example minimum_experience_years=3, rather than only as free text.
Skills should have both hard_skill and inferred_post_joining_skill fields.
A circular should have source_document_id, page_number, extraction_confidence and original_text fields so every normalized job can be traced back to the source.

source_traceability.BARI: The BARI PDF is a 3-page image-based official circular; page 1 contains posts 1-14, page 2 contains posts 15-30 and recruitment conditions, and page 3 contains online application/payment instructions.
source_traceability.BRRI_02: The BRRI 3 PDF is a 3-page official circular; page 1 contains posts 1-19, page 2 contains posts 20-27 and application conditions, and page 3 contains additional online application instructions.
source_traceability.BRRI_01: The BRRI 4 PDF is a 2-page official circular; page 1 contains the five job categories and page 2 contains application/payment instructions.
